title: Arrow B: a feeling must imprint itself on neurons to be reported

statements.text: Besides the gap from neurons to feeling, Arrow A, there is a second gap, Arrow B: how a feeling, once produced, would cause the specific neural information that lets a person think and say that it is present. Without Arrow B the reported consciousness cannot be the produced one.

sources.quote: I call this second process Arrow B
Theories that propose an Arrow A but ignore Arrow B are not explanatory.
